title: Nonlocal Generalized Dirac Oscillators in (1 + 1) Dimensions
summary: We propose a nonlocal extension of the generalized Dirac oscillator (GDO) in $(1+1)$ dimensions by replacing the multiplicative interaction $f(x)$ with an integral operator $\hat F$ with kernel $f(x,x')$. The resulting Dirac equation preserves an operator factorization and decouples into two nonlocal Schrödinger-type (Sturm--Liouville) equations for the spinor components.
